chapter.heading: Praise to God in His Holiness and MajestyA Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Give unto
the Lord, O you mighty ones,Give unto the Lord glory and strength. [Prov. 1:1]

Give unto
the Lord the glory due to His name;Worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness. [Ps. 39:5, 6; 62:9; 144:4; Eccl. 12:8 c [Rom. 8:20, 21]]

The voice
of the Lord is over the waters;The God of glory thunders;The Lord is over many waters. [Eccl. 2:22; 3:9]

The voice
of the Lord is powerful;The voice of the Lord is full of majesty. [Ps. 104:5; 119:90]

The voice
of the Lord breaks the cedars,Yes, the Lord splinters the cedars of Lebanon. [Ps. 19:4-6 3 Is]

He makes
them also skip like a calf,Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox. [Eccl. 11:5; John 3:8]

The voice
of the Lord divides the flames of fire. [[Ps. 104:8, 9; Jer. 5:22]]

The voice
of the Lord shakes the wilderness;The Lord shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh. [Prov. 27:20; Eccl. 4:8]

The voice
of the Lord makes the deer give birth,And strips the forests bare;And in His temple everyone says, “Glory!” [Eccl. 3:15 describing insatiable appetite (4:8; 5:10; compare Prov. 27:20)]

The Lord
sat enthroned at the Flood,And the Lord sits as King forever.

The Lord
will give strength to His people;The Lord will bless His people with peace. [Eccl. 2:16]
